evidence.fact: Imports SingletonAutoRescheduleFlag from baserow.celery_singleton_backend, tying the constructed class to the target production module.
The named test overrides settings.AUTO_INDEX_LOCK_EXPIRY to 7, constructs SingletonAutoRescheduleFlag("test_lock") without a timeout argument, and asserts flag.timeout == 14.
